article.title: 港話通加入YuE2音樂創作，哼唱或相片可作起點
article.title_en: HKChat adds YuE2 music creation from humming or photos
article.summary: 香港新聞網10月30日報道，港話通已推出接入HKGAI自研YuE2的音樂功能，主打粵語流行曲。
article.summary_en: Hong Kong China News Agency reported on October 30 that HKChat added music generation using HKGAI’s YuE2, emphasizing Cantonese pop.
article.why: 本地創意團隊可評估粵語音樂概念草稿，減少早期構思的表達門檻。
article.why_en: Local creative teams can assess Cantonese musical sketches for early concept development.
article.next_step: 先以自有素材試做內部示範，公開或商用前查清授權與聲音權利。
article.next_step_en: Use owned inputs for an internal concept and check commercial-use and voice rights before publication.
highlights: 用戶可哼唱旋律，或上載相片並補充歌曲構思。
首頁底部設音樂入口，現階段免費開放體驗。
highlights_en: Users can supply humming or a photo with a song concept.
A Music entry appears on the home screen; trial access is currently free.
article.detail:
香港新聞網10月30日報道，港話通已推出接入HKGAI自研YuE2的音樂功能，主打粵語流行曲。

用戶可哼唱旋律，或上載相片並補充歌曲構思。

首頁底部設音樂入口，現階段免費開放體驗。

本地創意團隊可評估粵語音樂概念草稿，減少早期構思的表達門檻。

先以自有素材試做內部示範，公開或商用前查清授權與聲音權利。

報道未交代商用授權或權利保障；免費體驗不等於可商用，本刊未測試音質或粵語準確度。
article.detail_en:
Hong Kong China News Agency reported on October 30 that HKChat added music generation using HKGAI’s YuE2, emphasizing Cantonese pop.

Users can supply humming or a photo with a song concept.

A Music entry appears on the home screen; trial access is currently free.

Local creative teams can assess Cantonese musical sketches for early concept development.

Use owned inputs for an internal concept and check commercial-use and voice rights before publication.

The reports do not establish commercial licensing or rights guarantees. Free access is not commercial permission; quality and Cantonese accuracy were not tested.
